description: Search the public tennis tournament calendar of Tennis Control (www.tenniscontrol.es): national federations of 50+ countries, Tennis Europe, ITF Juniors, ATF, COSAT, COTECC, and professional tours (ATP, Challenger, WTA, ITF). Filter by country, region, category, circuit, dates, text or open registration. Returns dates, venue, categories, entry deadline and the official link where entries are made (Tennis Control never handles entries). Only tournaments ending today or later unless 'from' is given.

category.description: Age category: U10, U12, U14, U16, JR (U18), ABS (open/adults), or veterans V30…V80 ('V' = any veterans). Spanish names accepted (alevín, infantil, cadete, júnior, absoluto)

circuit.description: Circuit code or name: te (Tennis Europe), itf (ITF Juniors), atf, cosat, cotecc, atp, chal, wta, wta125, itfp, isq (Spain iSQUAD), fat (Andorra), fitp, fft, dtb… Use list_circuits

country.description: Country: name (Spanish or English) or code, e.g. 'España', 'Italy', 'FR', 'GER', 'AD'

from.description: Start of date range (YYYY-MM-DD). Default: today

open_entries.description: Only tournaments whose entry deadline has not passed yet

region.description: Region or province, e.g. 'Cataluña', 'Madrid', 'Lombardia'. For Spain, autonomous communities

text.description: Free text in name, venue or notes (e.g. a city or club)

name: search_tournaments
title: Buscar torneos de tenis
